name: Stormkit

evidence.static: 04: Stormkit Cloud deploys static front ends and frameworks from source or build files
evidence.panel: 03: self-hosted Stormkit runs on the customer's own infrastructure; the Cloud runtimes for long-running apps are self-hosted only

line: Build and deploy sites on Stormkit Cloud or your own infrastructure.

free.text: Free Cloud plan; advertised unlimited use, no numeric quotas

cells.regions: Cloud app regions unlisted; self-host uses your server
cells.selfhost: Yes; AGPLv3 Community; Enterprise is paid

work.math: $0 a month is the listed subscription fee. Numeric build and bandwidth limits, custom-domain plan access and full usage terms are not specified.
$20 a month is the listed seat fee. Functions allow up to 15 seconds per call, but memory, total quotas and full workload fit are not priced.
The homepage FAQ says Cloud includes managed Postgres. The current docs and README say the database is self-hosted only, and no database price is published.
